node.statement: From the dependency A_J=A and u_{A_J}=R, and from 0<=W.c0_cb*epsilon<=t, lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone upgrades w to an extended t-inclusion with codomain A_J. Taking U=J, epsilon_J=t, B_J=C^m, v_J=w, the fixed amplifications, d_J=t, and the extended-inclusion tag gives every field required by def-maincb-reset-state; J is a nonempty union of all classes. Adjoining this reset-state reference to the explicitly fixed finite J,A,w,P_j, relation and class family gives every field required by def-maincb-partition-state for the same A,w.
